mechanism: Sumatriptan (5-HT1B/1D agonist) combined with perphenazine (dopamine antagonist) increases serotonergic activity and risk of serotonin syndrome; perphenazine also increases CNS depression and may potentiate vasoconstrictive effects.
action: Monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia); use lowest effective doses; consider alternative antipsychotic with less serotonergic interaction; educate patient on warning signs.
